title: Run the four Arduino sketch cases once arduino-cli is installed (owner opt-in)
goal: The four embedded sketch cases run and are recorded in the Gauntlet ledger after the owner opts in to installing arduino-cli
acceptance: The owner opts in to arduino-cli with arduino:avr 1.8.6 and esp32:esp32 3.0.7 on the Mac (not asked for on 2026-11-26)

embedded/blink-millis-esp32-regression, embedded/debounce-toggle-uno-regression, embedded/pwm-fade-esp32-holdout and embedded/serial-command-uno-holdout run (--allow-models --allow-expensive) and are recorded in evals/gauntlet/ledger.json
Run in the development checkout, never ~/.nerv-app; not while the owner uses the local model
privacy: Neutral invented data only; no secrets, tokens, private channel IDs or personal data in Git.
escalation: Installing arduino-cli and its cores is the owner's opt-in; never install it unasked

effort.estimate: 0.5 h agent after the owner opts in
effort.basis: Moved 2026-11-26 out of F-120-T04 (owner: "Close nerv:F-120-T04 ok") so that step can close; about one embedded run plus recording. Not a measurement.
